newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of Communications in 600 mln yuan subway loan.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Communications in 600 mln yuan subway loan.

text.p: China's Bank of Communications on Monday signed a contract to loan 600 million yuan to the Shanghai City Construction Development Company for the city's second subway line, Shanghai Television said.
The station's evening newscast gave no further details of the loan.

The 13.6-km subway will run from the Jing'ansi shopping area in western Shanghai to the Pudong area in the east. It is expected to cost 10.5 billion yuan ($1.27bn) and is scheduled to open on January 1, 2000.
